# DSN parser contract

parseDsn accepts strings of the form 'scheme://host:port/database' where scheme is exactly 'postgres'. host is a nonempty string without slashes. port is an integer 1..65535, defaulting to 5432 when ':port' is omitted. database is a nonempty segment after the first slash following the authority. Return {scheme, host, port, database}.
